app.title: Image analysis
app.subtitle: Wildfire observation · Sentinel-2
app.footerNote: Rule-based detection. Review the results before interpreting them.

intro.title: One image. A clearer picture.
intro.body: Outline burned areas, identify active hotspots, and explore each analysis layer.

upload.title: Scene images
upload.help: You can start with a single PNG or JPG image. We recommend combining True Color and SWIR of the same scene.
upload.or: or select them from your device
upload.formats: PNG and JPG · up to 100 MiB and 100 million pixels per image
upload.guessHelp: We recognize SWIR, True Color, and Wildfire from filenames. Otherwise, we use the visual suggestion. Your manual selection always takes priority.
upload.needsType: Select a type for each image before analysis.
upload.limit: Up to {{max}} images: one of each type.
upload.missing: Add a SWIR or True Color image for analysis. Wildfire provides a validation reference.
upload.duplicate: Assign only one image to each composition type.
upload.swirHelp: B12 · B8A · B4. Improves burned-area identification.
upload.truecolorHelp: Natural color for interpreting the scene and smoke.
upload.wildfireHelp: Optional reference for hotspot validation. It does not contribute to detection.
upload.mismatch: The images have different aspect ratios. They will resize to the base image dimensions without correcting alignment.
upload.replace: You can remove or change images before another analysis.

settings.title: Analysis options
settings.resolutionHelp: Longest side of the analyzed image. A lower resolution reduces waiting time.
settings.imageOnly: Results use pixels and image percentages.

progress.title: Your scene is being analyzed
progress.help: Progress follows real processing stages. Duration depends on the image.
progress.reconnect: The analysis status could not be retrieved. Retry without repeating the analysis.

result.title: Explore the scene
result.ready: Analysis complete. The results are available.
result.scrollHelp: When zoomed in, use arrow keys to scroll the viewer. The comparison slider also supports arrow keys.
result.frontHelp: Estimated boundary sectors near accepted hotspots. These are not a measured fire-progression line.
result.simulationHelp: Approximate simulation for preview only. Downloads retain the original palette.
result.previewError: A layer could not load. Check the API connection and analyze again if necessary.

metrics.title: The scene in numbers
metrics.rangeHelp: The upper bound includes probable burn beneath smoke.
metrics.imagePixels: Pixels at analysis resolution, not at original file resolution.

description.title: Result description
description.detected: A burned area of {{pixels}} pixels is detected, covering {{percent}}% of valid pixels in the {{direction}} part of the image.
description.none: No burned area was detected in the image.
description.probable: Another {{pixels}} pixels are estimated as probable burn beneath smoke. This category is less reliable and remains separate.
description.water: Interior water is excluded from the burned area, and unburned islands are preserved.
description.alt: Wildfire analysis with {{pixels}} burned pixels and {{count}} accepted hotspots. A description and table follow the viewer.

notes.title: Analysis context and limitations
notes.no_truecolor: Without True Color, smoke and water separation is less reliable.
notes.reference_only: Wildfire only validates hotspots after detection. It does not add hotspots to the result.
notes.truecolor_only: Only True Color is used. Flame detection is less reliable, and recovering burn beneath smoke requires SWIR.
notes.smoke_low: Some smoke fragments have low confidence. They appear separately and do not contribute to burn recovery or hotspot validation.
notes.under_smoke: Probable burn beneath smoke is an estimate, not a confirmed area.
notes.smoke_obscured: Part of the perimeter is near smoke. The area can be underestimated.
notes.composition_mismatch: The image assigned as SWIR resembles another composition. Review its assignment before interpreting the result.

hotspots.title: Active hotspots
hotspots.help: Select a hotspot to highlight it in the viewer. All positions are image coordinates.
hotspots.caption: Accepted hotspots in this analysis
hotspots.empty: There are no accepted active hotspots.

reasons.truecolor_only: Detected only in True Color: lower reliability
reasons.other: Additional engine reason (included in the JSON report)

export.title: Take the results with you
export.help: The PNG uses the current base image and visible layers. The report retains the complete analysis.
export.zipHelp: The ZIP includes reports, the result image, analyzed compositions, layers, and masks, including hidden layers.
export.masksHelp: These black-and-white PNGs separate one category, such as burned area, water, or smoke.
export.masksValues: White (255): pixels in that category. Black (0): the rest of the image.
export.masksResolution: They use analysis resolution. Use them to isolate regions and reuse them in other programs.
export.resolutionNote: All measurements use analysis resolution. The fire front is a visual estimate.
export.csvEmpty: The CSV will contain headers with no hotspot rows.

errors.network: Could not connect to the API. Check that the Python server is running.
errors.invalid_image: The file is not a valid PNG or JPG image.
errors.file_too_large: The image exceeds the 100 MiB limit.
errors.too_many_images: Upload up to 3 images: one SWIR, one True Color, and an optional Wildfire. Remove an image before adding another.
errors.invalid_compositions: Assign a different type to each image and include at least SWIR or True Color.
errors.invalid_response: The API returned an incompatible result format. See the browser console for details and check the server version.
errors.duplicate_image: An image cannot fill two composition types.
errors.invalid_request: The analysis options are invalid. Review the images and settings.
errors.upload_not_found: The image is no longer available. Upload it again if you restarted the API.
errors.job_not_found: This analysis is no longer available. You can start a new one.
errors.file_not_found: The requested file is no longer available.
errors.analysis_failed: The server could not complete the analysis. Review the submitted images and the error in the Python terminal.
errors.export_failed: The file could not be generated. Check the connection and try again.
errors.clipboard: The text could not be copied. You can select and copy it manually.
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.
errors.heading: The action could not complete
